Added `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)` to src/invoices.js that assigns a number, changes status to 'issued', and rejects non-draft invoices.

Added 8 tests for numbering (empty list, incrementing, multiple numbers, year reset, filtering other years/invalid numbers, zero-padding, high counters) and 5 tests for issueInvoice (basic flow, year reset, rejection, non-mutation). All 53 tests pass.
